nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, let $F_n$ be the free group on $n$ generators. The free metabelian group of rank $n$ is the quotient $M_n = F_n / F_n''$ of $F_n$ by its second derived subgroup $F_n'' = [[F_n, F_n], [F_n, F_n]]$.
nodes.title: Free metabelian group of rank $n$ (Kourovka 19.94)

nodes.summary: It is not the case that for every natural number $n$ and all words $w_1, w_2$ in the free group $F_n$ of rank $n$, the words $w_1$ and $w_2$ have the same distribution if and only if some automorphism of the free metabelian group $M_n = F_n / F_n''$ maps the image of $w_1$ in $M_n$ to the image of $w_2$.
nodes.title: Equally distributed elements need not be automorphic (Kourovka 19.94)

nodes.summary: The statement that for every natural number $n$ and all words $w_1, w_2$ in the free group $F_n$ of rank $n$, the words $w_1$ and $w_2$ have the same distribution if and only if some automorphism of the free metabelian group $M_n = F_n / F_n''$ maps the image of $w_1$ in $M_n$ to the image of $w_2$.
nodes.title: Timoshenko's question on equally distributed elements (Kourovka 19.94)

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number and $F_n$ the free group on generators $x_1, \dots, x_n$. Words $w_1, w_2 \in F_n$ have the same distribution when, for every finite metabelian group $G$ (that is, $G'' = 1$) and every $g \in G$, the number of tuples $(a_1, \dots, a_n) \in G^n$ with $w_1(a_1, \dots, a_n) = g$ equals the number of tuples with $w_2(a_1, \dots, a_n) = g$.
